item.title: Simple Sprout Shop Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my plant shop, Little Sprout. Just a simple green sprout above the name on white, nothing fancy.

item.tests: Produces a usable simple logo combining a clear mark and a readable business name.

answer_sheet.Mark and style: A simple green sprout above the name; clean and unfussy.

must_haves: A recognizable, simple green sprout sits above the name.
The square image contains a flat logo, not a photograph or merchandise mockup.

args.name: Little Sprout — Clean Plant Shop Logo

style.prompt: Create a simple, clean logo for a plant shop named "little sprout". Exact text: "little sprout", all lowercase, beautifully legible modern rounded sans-serif typography. A minimal sprout icon with two small leaves and one graceful stem, centered above the wordmark. Flat vector-style design, elegant balanced proportions, generous negative space, restrained deep botanical green on a pure white background. Friendly, fresh, contemporary boutique plant shop identity. One polished logo only, centered in a square canvas. No mockup, no photography, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no border, no extra text, no tagline.
